steps.description: Full replace semantics: when provided, this array becomes the complete set of the flow's steps — any existing step not included here is deleted. Omit the field entirely to leave steps untouched. Each step's own `conditions` field follows the same rule at the step level: omitted preserves the existing conditions on that step, while `[]` deletes all of that step's conditions.

transitionFunctions.description: Full replace semantics: when provided, this array becomes the complete set of the flow's transition functions — any existing transition function not included here is deleted. Omit the field entirely to leave transition functions untouched.

isPolyVoice.description: True if this is a Poly-curated voice (vs account-owned)

id.description: Audio cache entry ID. Although serialized as a string, the ID is numeric — endpoints that accept an `entryId` path parameter return `400 Invalid ID` if the value cannot be parsed as an integer.

VoiceTuningConfig.description: Provider-specific voice tuning settings. All fields are optional — each TTS provider uses a different subset.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier. 1.0 is normal speed

modelId.description: TTS model ID, specific to the provider (e.g. 'eleven_turbo_v2')

ids.description: List of audio cache entry IDs to delete (max 20)

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value pairs delivered to the agent as SIP headers. All values must be strings. The base64 representation must be under 26 KB.

get.description:
List the connector token for each client environment of an agent.

Only environments that already have a connector are returned. Use the PUT endpoint to create one for an environment that is missing.

The connector token is the per-environment credential a telephony or websocket integration presents so PolyAI routes the call to this agent in that environment. SIP integrations pass it as `X-PolyAi-Auth-Token` in the SIP URI and websocket integrations pass it as the `X-PolyAi-Auth-Token` custom parameter. It is not an API key. Treat it as a secret.

401.description: Unauthorized – missing or invalid API key
